name: MIRARTH HOLDINGS,Inc.
summary: MIRARTH HOLDINGS,Inc. engages in the real estate business in Japan. It plans, develops, sells, and trades in condominiums under the Leben and Nebel brands; detached housing sales business; real estate asset liquidation business; renovation and resale business; and provides real estate asset management, condominium management, and brokerage services. The company also engages in the renewable electric power generation and sales, as well as the provision of investment opportunities and asset management services to various investors.
